paraphrase: A10C says that the respondent’s reports appear to provide a prima-facie reason to think there is, more likely than not, a Necessary Being. Its causal-default/first-contingent argument and modal conditional remain the stated grounds, and the author expressly allows counter-reasons that defeat the implication. This attributes a defeasible evidential conclusion; it does not establish a numeric probability, undefeated rational warrant, actual Necessary Being or premise truth.
